name: destination-picker
title: Destination Picker
description: Choose where something goes — spaces, their folders, recents, search, refusals with a reason.

meta.whenToUse: A Move to… dialog: moving a page, file, folder, table, task or meeting into a space or folder.
meta.whenNotToUse: Picking a record to link (RecordPicker) or a space alone (SpacePicker).
